{"script":"cat > init_logs.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p log_files
rm -f log_files/log*.log
msgs=("Connection established" "Connection closed" "User login" "User logout" "Request processed" "Error detected" "Service restarted" "Disk space checked")
for i in {1..10}; do
  lines=$((RANDOM%6+5))
  : > "log_files/log${i}.log"
  for ((j=1;j<=lines;j++)); do
    ts=$(printf "202%d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d" $((RANDOM%3+2)) $((RANDOM%12+1)) $((RANDOM%28+1)) $((RANDOM%24)) $((RANDOM%60)) $((RANDOM%60)))
    msg=${msgs[RANDOM%${#msgs[@]}]}
    printf '%s %s\n' "$ts" "$msg" >> "log_files/log${i}.log"
  done
done
EOF
chmod +x init_logs.sh
cat > count_lines.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
wc -l log_files/*.log | awk 'END{print $1}'
EOF
chmod +x count_lines.sh
./init_logs.sh >/dev/null
./count_lines.sh"}
